SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-04-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-04-2022 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF SHAHRAM MOSHENI IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM. DEFENDANT UBER TECHNOLOGIES IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY MICHELLE BUI, PARALEGAL. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE OF OWNING INTERESTS IN UBER STOCK - BOTH PARTIES BOTH PARTIES SIGNED AND DATED A WAIVER OF DISQUALIFICATION WHICH WAS FILED BY THE COURT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
